text_block_list.text: The day of the Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I'm definitely gonna make a miracle 
happen! So, come watch!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Well then, see you again next week.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ! Ruby...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I will get straight to the point.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Helios will be running in today's 
Arima Kinen, and she requested that you 
come watch.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I know. It's amazing. Quite a bold 
challenge, too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I... ...Sorry, I have to go to 
Helios—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I did not come here to act as a messenger.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to escort you to Nakayama 
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, why...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Helios says she will make a miracle 
happen at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Helios's ability is the real deal. 
With her legs, even if the distance is 
outside her aptitude, her chances are by 
no means zero.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Above all... there is "something" special 
about Helios's running, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Being able to feel so thrilled and 
give hope to someone else... It's so free, 
and wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps that 'something'... is what we 
call a miracle."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I shall place my bet. On this uncertainty, 
I will endeavor to find another light.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san, you too... shall bear witness 
to its conclusion.
(Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah...!)

The "Arima Kinen"—partly because a 
star-studded field chosen by the fans' 
votes was competing, Nakayama Racecourse 
was buzzing with intense excitement.

While the crowd's attention was centered 
on Tokai Teio and Rice Shower, who had 
proven their strength along the classic 
royal road—

text_block_list.name: Helios & Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ayyy~â

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Palmer and Helios! Talk about 
radiant energy!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Blow 'em away, Palma-Heli~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me-shi!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios and me, the ultimate BFF duo!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna tear it up like crazy! Hype me 
up moreeee!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Those two are so fun to watch run, I love 
it~! They're definitely worth keeping an 
eye on, favorites aside!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Like, there's no way Helios can handle 
2,500 meters, and she's probably just 
treating it like coming to a festival, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
Helios, you didn't have to come all the 
way over here... I just wanted to watch 
the race seriously, you know.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I'm... here.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby... I—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
For now, let us simply watch over her. And 
see what her running will bring about—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fo' real!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Did Mira and Ruby come!?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I spotted them in the stands.
Yeah, I spotted them in the stands.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Palmer-chin! I get it.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Trainy-P! Gimme the usual!

I look back on the races I've run with 
Daitaku Helios so far. Speaking of the 
"usual" routine we did together before 
each race—
choice_data_list: ...There's no way that's a thing, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well, just go with the vibe, ya know? Hit 
me with some nice call-outs!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If you don't hype me up, Trainy-P, it 
ain't even startin'!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyyy~â

While improvising call-and-responses, I 
look back. Ever since I first met Daitaku 
Helios...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I just wanna hype myself up, y'know? I'm 
confident I can make noise anywhere! Just 
depends on my mood~

She, who loves having fun, is always 
cheerful, and treasures the "now" so 
deeply—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Why don't we just throw a massive party!?
She's trying to run for someone's sake...

"No matter what result awaits, Daitaku 
Helios will surely grasp something brand 
new in today's race."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hell yeahhhâ

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's go all out, Palm-chin! —The biggest 
ruckus the Earth has ever seen!
